title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: declarative agents ground answers in scanned PDFs from SharePoint
summary: Hold: the low cost rating means indirect costs only, but the briefing correctly documents a metered Copilot Credits route for SharePoint-grounded agents. The roadmap facts, control paths, commands and billing prerequisites are supported; the absence of a scanned-PDF-specific rate does not remove the documented consumption cost.

claims.claim: A low cost rating, meaning indirect costs only, is consistent with the documented metered SharePoint-grounding route.

cost: "low"
Low. Reviewing scanned-document libraries creates admin and maker work. Microsoft documents SharePoint knowledge through a Copilot licence or metered usage, but no scanned-PDF-specific charge or meter is published.
claims.fix: Set cost to variable. Replace the cost rationale with: 'Variable. SharePoint-grounded declarative agents can use usage-based billing measured in Copilot Credits; Microsoft has not published a rate specific to scanned-PDF grounding.' The metered route is stated at https://learn.microsoft.com/plugins/prerequisites#agent-capabilities-and-licensing-models; a separate feature-specific meter is not required for the standard's variable rating.
